subject: architecture_plan

findings.detail: ReservationService is a single facade; a narrower read-only lookup port could be split out later, but one facade is acceptable at standard density.

summary: Two modules with clear, non-overlapping responsibilities. One directed dependency (reservation -> inventory) with a stated reason, and a forbid_dependency constraint on the reverse edge that matches the stated rationale (keep inventory reusable independent of hold/TTL/authZ). No responsibility, boundary, ownership, or checkability gaps.
